post.description: Save an uploaded image as assets/cover.webp (resized, re-encoded) and set book.json cover.
Use one page of a volume's PDF (rendered if needed) as the book cover.
Upload the volume's PDF. It is streamed to workdir/ with a size cap, then checked.

schema.title: Response Ocr Queue Api Books  Book  Volumes  Volume  Ocr Queue Get

post.description: Keep the page's existing raw text and clear this candidate from the queue.

With `dryRun`, only plan: which pages would be called and how many calls that is.

Several models: each page is called once per model and every page goes to the queue.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api Jobs Get

post.description: Run again only what has no good result yet.
With `dryRun`, only plan: the calls, and what blocks (hard) or warns (soft) before it.
